title: McTeacher Night Raises $5,725 for Six LISD Elementary Schools
excerpt: McDonald’s of Laredo hand-delivered checks totaling $5,725 to six LISD elementary schools for McTeacher Night, with the company donating 20 percent of sales back to local schools in the 17th year of the fundraiser.
content:
McDonald’s of Laredo hand-delivered checks to six Laredo Independent School District elementary schools for taking part in McDonald’s McTeacher Night, during a ceremony at the LISD Amber Yeary Board Room, the district announced.

The schools — Dovalina, Hachar, Tarver, Santo Niño, Ligarde and Leyendecker Elementary — raised a total of $5,725, according to the district. McDonald’s donates 20 percent of all sales to local schools during McTeacher Night, and staff at each school sold cookies to help raise funds for their campus.

Mike Marasco, president of McDonald’s Restaurants in Laredo, and Sabrina Teeters, marketing manager, presented the checks to the principals and students of the six schools, the district said. Board President Veronica V. Orduno, Board Parliamentarian Rodolfo “Rudy” Morales and Superintendent Guillermo Pro also attended.

This is the 17th year McDonald’s has sponsored McTeacher Night, according to the district. McDonald’s of Laredo has also sponsored the LISD scoreboard at Shirley Field since it was installed in 2013, contributed to the district’s Leadership Meetings and Martin-Nixon Rivalry Week, and last May awarded scholarships to LISD high school students who also work at McDonald’s.

Sources: Laredo Independent School District, Nov. 19, 2026.
